mapper.select: SELECT s.song_id, s.title AS song_title, al.title AS album_title, ar.name AS artist_name, g.name AS genre_name FROM songs_tbl s JOIN albums_tbl al ON s.album_id = al.album_id JOIN artists_tbl ar ON s.artist_id = ar.artist_id LEFT JOIN song_genre_tbl sg ON s.song_id = sg.song_id LEFT JOIN genres_tbl g ON sg.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE s.song_id = #{songId}
